name: Nephron (Renal Filtration Unit)
semanticDescription: Medical-grade anatomical 3D model of a kidney nephron conforming to NCERT Class 10/11 specifications. Includes Bowman's capsule with hollow cup, glomerulus capillary tuft, wide afferent arteriole, narrow efferent arteriole, proximal convoluted tubule (PCT), loop of Henle (thin descending limb, hairpin turn, thick ascending limb) entering macula densa contact with vascular pole, distal convoluted tubule (DCT), branched collecting duct, peritubular capillaries, hairpin vasa recta, and frosted corticomedullary boundary plane. Features dual collections (Nephron_Full and Nephron_Section) for full context and clean isolated tubule views.
simplifications: Tubular convolutions simplified to primary pedagogical anatomical loops for visual clarity.
Corticomedullary boundary represented by a subtle demarcation plane between cortex and medulla.

materials.look: Double-walled epithelial cup with realistic tissue subsurface scattering
Dense high-pressure capillary plexus (bright crimson red)
Slender hairpin medullary countercurrent loop (thin descending limb, thick ascending limb)
Thicker vertical urine collection trunk (pale golden yellow)
Intertwined capillary plexus and straight vasa recta for reabsorption
Subtle translucent demarcation plane between renal cortex and medulla
